mentions.name: Custom Go static site generator
mentions.description: A small static site generator written in Go, built by the author as a lighter replacement for Grav to minimize the dependencies they have to maintain; it has undergone basic load testing.
mentions.problem: Maintaining dependencies becomes harder the more software is used, so the author wanted a minimal alternative to Grav.
mentions.source_excerpt: Recently migrated over from Grav to a smaller SSG that I made myself in Go, the idea being that I'll minimize the dependencies I have to maintain, since that becomes harder and harder the more software I use. Even did some basic load testing, seems good so far: https://blog.kronis.dev/blog/i-rebuilt-my-blog-and-then-broke-it/
